injection_strategy: Added 307 to the condition that changes POST to GET and drops the body. Per RFC 7231, 307 must preserve method and body. The bug treats 307 like 301/302 and incorrectly drops the body.
expected_failure_summary: POST requests receiving 307 redirects have their body dropped and method changed to GET. Tests expecting the body to be re-submitted on 307 will fail.
calibration_notes: Medium difficulty: model must know RFC 7231 section 6.4 semantics for 307 vs 301/302, find the condition in onResponseStart, and remove 307 from it.
